640-4279-4314--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-4279-4314--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3363-8187.description:
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Return The One Ring to your hand using Essence Reliquary.
Repeat each turn.

797-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
797-4881-6909.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-6026--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7825.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
6797-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-5997-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa
1618-2440-5997-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-5997-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

3197-4120-6797-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
3197-4120-6797-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Herd Baloth, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2173-3944-4446-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2173-3944-4446-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 2 or higher

1318-3464-5352.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-3464-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Hyrax Tower Scout and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Hyrax Tower Scout and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Hyrax Tower Scout and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-3464-5352.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Hyrax Tower Scout. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2292-5058-6351.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1315-4826-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
1315-4826-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

579-1491-2464-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
579-1491-2464-6218.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
579-1491-2464-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4636-5159-5921.description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Iraxxa trigger, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

586-2713-4050-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Gix token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Boonweaver Giant

678-891-2719-4050-5214.notablePrerequisites: Next of Kin attached to Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
678-891-2719-4050-5214.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, adding one mana of any color.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, Enduring Renewal and Next of Kin trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Next of Kin trigger, putting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Boonweaver Giant.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Next of Kin from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

1339-4691-5213.notablePrerequisites:
Trespasser's Curse attached to you.
You have a way to draw a card.
1339-4691-5213.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Trespasser's Curse, causing you to lose 1 life and gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2107-2816-3430.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Sunastian Falconer.
Sunastian Falconer does not have summoning sickness.
2107-2816-3430.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding six {C}.
Activate Sunastian Falconer by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1496-2034-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1} and either {W} or two life.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion, causing it to enter the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1171-1322-1409.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

176-4050-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4050-4875.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Repeat.

60-1534.manaNeeded: {U}{U}{U/R}{U/R}, plus enough mana to cast the additional spell if needed
60-1534.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cast an additional instant or sorcery, or an opponent is casting one.
60-1534.description:
Cast any other instant and/or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying {U/R}{U/R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value four or less.
Cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell cast in step 1.
The delayed trigger from Expansion triggers, copying Twincast, with the copy targeting the original Twincast.
Resolve the copy of Twincast, copying Twincast, with the copy targeting the original Twincast.
Repeat step 5.

618-3277-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
The token copy of Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

776-1306-1329-2709.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1306-1329-2709.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Mana Crypt to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Mana Crypt.
Cast Mana Crypt.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1395-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat
